title.value: Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act
title.provenance: SEC. 1. This act shall be known, and may be cited, as the Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act.

location.provenance: AB-2515 Menstrual products: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS). (2023-2024)

reference.provenance: AB-2515 Menstrual products: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS). (2023-2024)

status.provenance: An act to add Article 15 (commencing with Section 25258) to Chapter 6.5 of Division 20 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health.

pfas_definition.provenance: ÒPerfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substancesÓ or ÒPFASÓ means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

date.provenance: Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product, including the PFAS components of intentionally added chemicals and PFAS that are intentional breakdown products of an added chemical that also have a functional or technical effect in the product.
